field_notes.hp: max health at spawn before stage multiplier (Mad Forest enemy_health = 1.0)

field_notes.knockback: multiplier on weapon knockback (0 = wiki lists 0, i.e. described as semi/fully resistant depending on page text; negative = pulled toward player)
field_notes.hp_x_level: true means health is multiplied by the player's level at spawn time

unknowns: Wiki gives HP x Level as a multiplier but not the exact formula (assumed hp * playerLevel, same as Mad Forest).
Speed unit vs player MoveSpeed unit not stated; the Dairy Plant enemy_speed modifier x1.25 is NOT baked into these speed values.

Enemy names on the Dairy Plant page are mostly community-made from internal ids; Merman 1 = FISHMAN_1, Merman 2 = MERMA1_3, Merman 3/Elite Merman = MERMA2_4, Elite Skeleton Ninja = SKELENIN2 (redirect), Sturdy Milk Elemental = MILK2 (redirect).

Wave-table 'Merman' rows do not say which of the 3 Merman variants; plain 'Merman' is approximated as FISHMAN_1 (Merman 1). At 7:00 the table lists a Merman-2 sprite (MERMA1_3), a Lizard Pawn and a plain Merman (FISHMAN_1).
Wave-table 'Skeleton' shows up to 3 sprite variants (SKELETON, SKELETON2, SKELETON3); all share the same stats in the reused SKELETON entry.
Wave-table 'Minotaur Boss' rows with the second sprite (10:00, 23:00, 28:00) are BOSS_MIGNO2_5_L (per the Minotaur Boss page appearances); 3:00/5:00/9:00 are BOSS_MIGNO2_5.
Big Golem: 20:00 normal is XLGOLEM1 (Golem 2 normal is 'N/A' on the wiki); 20:00 boss is BOSS_XLGOLEM2 and 22:00 boss is BOSS_XLGOLEM1; 29:00 'Massive Golem' = both LV29 variants.
Statboxes for Lizard Rook (1:00 boss), Axe Guardian and the 24:00 Giant Armored Knight list no HP x Level skill; treated as fixed-HP entries. The 24:00 boss slot has no chest on the wiki.
Milk Elemental 2 at 6:00 Swarm is the sturdy variant MILK2; the 1:00-2:00 Swarm uses MILK.
Pile Assault enemies (PILE1-3) have speed 0 and fire the BULLET_* projectiles; bullet stats copied from their pages, behaviour not modelled.
The Stalker statbox lists health 2,550 with HP x Level; the XL/cart variants on that page are not used here.
